repair.title: Tanker Oil Spills Fell
repair.summary: ITOPF reports that oil lost from tanker spills in the 2010s was 95 percent lower than in the 1970s.
repair.why_it_matters: Rules, ship design, navigation, and response systems made a dirty global industry less accident-prone.
repair.caveat: Oil spills still happen, and this metric covers tankers rather than all oil pollution.
